title: Justice Badar Durrez Ahmed on the Emergency his father proclaimed 51 years ago
description: Few Indian judges carry a personal history as entangled with the country's constitutional fault lines as Justice Badar Durrez Ahmed. His father, Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed, was the President who proclaimed Emergency on the night of June 25, 1975.His first legal mentor was one of the men who helped draft that very proclamation. And for nearly 50 years, a story has circulated about a private note his father is said to have written about that night and what became of it.In this interview with Bar & B
